desc:
Experience TDS: Reforged, an unofficial Tower Defense Simulator fan game focused on original custom content!

Deploy custom towers, battle unique enemies and bosses, explore new maps, and play original modes featuring new mechanics, upgrades, and challenges.

Create your own custom gamemodes by choosing the waves, enemies, bosses, rules, and difficulty, then test them with friends!

👥💵 Join the Vince Games group for +$100 starting cash!

👍 Like and favorite the game to support future updates! 🌟

TDS: Reforged is a fan-made project and is not affiliated with Paradoxum Games. 👍 and also thanks for tds ascended devs for giving us the game
